breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the inconsistency regarding the grid definition. The original prompt contained a contradictory preamble. The agent removed this entire preamble and presented only the correct, unambiguous grid specification for a periodic domain (Nx points, dx=1/Nx), which is consistent with the ground truth's resolution.
